arms.encoder_graph: train only source encoder and graph; freeze remaining source core and 12 integration scalars
arms.joint: train encoder, graph, remaining core and all 12 integration scalars

objective.boundary: exact SW0145 actual-spike local-boundary Q MSE against exp(-seam_RGB_MSE / fixed_s)
objective.preservation: exact SW0145 full off-diagonal MSE between student Q and detached initial source Q on the same clean inputs
objective.lambda_A: fixed from verified immutable SW0145 source0 report: 0.25 times median of its four common-input encoder+graph B/A gradient ratios; no recalibration, cap, or fallback
objective.optimizer: fresh Adam per arm; encoder LR 3e-6, graph/native core LR 3e-5, integration scalars LR 1e-3; global clip 1; project a_d/a_m to [0,1]

training.teacher: initial same-seed source model, float32 detached actual-spike Q

evaluation.ground_truth_access: after both candidate predictions, source97 seed1 and Slot seed1 prediction bytes and protocols are validated and rehashed

promotion.joint_fg_mean: strictly greater than source97 seed1 and encoder_graph control by 0.01
promotion.paired_fg_ci: 95% lower bounds of joint-control and joint-source per-image FG ARI differences both positive
promotion.iou: joint FG-IoU and object-IoU exceed registered three-seed Slot32 means by 0.05
promotion.failure: close the candidate without sweeps or automatic scaling

limits: A seed1 pilot does not prove all gating mechanisms or scaling.
No classifier, decoder, PLV, density, or learned readout changes.
Training requires a sealed admission file binding the verified SW0145 disposable report and completed SW0143 terminal score.
